posts.title:
This Lindsay Clancy Question Is Becoming A Dating Test.

The Lindsay Clancy case has become a dating litmus test. What does that mean for men and women?

link_metadata.description: A patient recently told me about his new test for whether a woman is marriage material. It isn’t politics, religion, or whether she wants children. He wants to know what she thinks about Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother who killed her three children.At first, I thought this was one man’s unusual dating rule. Then other men in my practice started bringing up the case. A murder case had somehow become a compatibility test.The question isn’t really about Lindsay Clancy. It’s much more personal: What does your answer tell me about what it would be like to build a life with you?Some men hear sympathy for Clancy and get nervous. When a woman says, “That could have been me,” they may not hear compassion for severe mental illness. They may hear someone identifying with a mother who killed her three children. Then come the questions: Does mental illness erase responsibility? Where does empathy end and excuse-making begin?
